ownership.quote: PandaStack is operated by pandastackio Inc. We build the PandaStack platform and publish the open-source project under Apache-2.0.

stage.note: No press release, Crunchbase/Tracxn profile, YC page, or investor mention found for pandastackio Inc. The company's own About page discloses only founding date and founder, with no mention of funding; could not confirm bootstrapped vs. a small unannounced round.

note: pandastackio Inc. was founded 2025-05-13 (per its own About page) by founder/CEO Ajay Kumar. PandaStack publishes its core platform as open source under Apache-2.0 while also operating a hosted/managed product (free + $20 Pro + $99 Team + custom Enterprise plans), i.e. an open-core / open-source-project-plus-hosted-SaaS model rather than a pure nonprofit open-source foundation. No accelerator, investor, funding round, or revenue figure could be found in public sources (no YC page, no Crunchbase/Tracxn data, no TechCrunch/press coverage, no HN Show/Launch post, no LinkedIn funding badge). Given the company's small size and lack of any funding announcement, bootstrapped is plausible but not confirmed, so stage and funding fields are left unknown rather than guessed.
